maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from selling billboard and airport advertising space to advertisers, not repairs, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private brands and advertisers buying billboard and airport campaigns; airport and transit concession partners are not the main payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through selling ads on its own billboard and airport displays and digital upgrades, not regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers buy campaign-based billboard space and can shift budget to other media or outdoor operators easily.
